review.review_type: Independent read-only source, protocol and cached-vector review
review.scope: Current DB-impact/SVRG audit only. No model forward/backward, scientific objective recomputation, training, or production edits.

findings.source_and_protocol: No blocking issue. Frozen source hash matches the protocol; strict small-database policy and prior 16-seed manifest are reused. State, cache, old receipts, and full-gradient inputs are hash-bound.
findings.singleton_cache: Each of 12 complete 251x9446 F64 caches preserves the prior subset bitwise. Missing rows are computed in global canonical order by the existing corrected singleton chemistry scalar; each full mean matches its saved gold with relative L2 <= 8.75e-16. The frozen validator records unchanged model/RNG state.
findings.db_weights_and_variance: Per-DB contributions use n_d/251 times the without-replacement K-sample mean. The finite-population weighted-MSE expression w_d^2*(n_d-K)/(K*(n_d-1))*mean(||g_j-mu_d||^2) is correct. I independently recomputed all 96 state/DB dispersion entries, all K1/K2/K4 theoretical MSEs, and empirical sampled-contribution MSEs from saved vectors; maximum absolute discrepancy was 5.69e-14. Median DB-mean cosine and signed cross-error attribution discrepancies were <= 7.78e-16 and 1.67e-16.
findings.leave_one_db_and_pair: Leave-one-DB-exact replaces only that DB sample contribution by its exact weighted mean, then recomputes UNIT_MAXMIN direction and gold true progress. Ranking matches the frozen lexicographic rule over 12 states x K1/K2/K4 x 16 shared draws: EA13, PA8, MGAE109, NCCE31, ABDE4, IP13, DBH76, pTC13. The selected EA13+PA8 pair uses the top-two rule and no pair search; its +0.11979 pooled success uplift is descriptive on this same selected panel, not independent confirmation. The report correctly says DB impact depends on K and does not label a universal harmful database.
findings.svrg_pairing_and_cases: The implemented vector is g_ref_full + g_sample(target) - g_sample(reference). Both sampled terms use the exact same manifest IDs, canonical variants, per-DB weights and K for each replicate. All 12 cases target u5 or u9 and use only strictly earlier u0/u5 references; no target equals its reference and no u0/reference-equals-target observation enters qualification. Target gold gradients are used only for truth scoring and the separately disclosed fullchem-direction comparison.
findings.independent_cached_replay: The frozen independent validator replays 4608 leave-one-DB, 576 top-pair, and 384 SVRG rows using cached arrays and face-enumerated simplex QPs; it reports zero hash mismatches, maximum true-progress replay error 5.43e-14 and maximum KKT residual 4.44e-16. I independently replayed all 384 CV rows and direction comparisons: max cosine discrepancy 7.78e-16, true-progress vector 5.67e-15, fullchem-direction cosine 8.89e-16, ordinary-direction cosine 4.41e-13, independent KKT residual 2.05e-16.
findings.literal_gates_and_selection: All four fixed CV candidates have 128/128 positive true p_full, 16/16 in each of their eight cases, zero tail failures, and qualified UNIT_MAXMIN solutions. The minimum cosine across candidates is 0.999999918 and minimum p_full is 0.143950766. The frozen gate (>=95% overall, >=90% each case, no p_full below -0.02 plus solver checks) is implemented literally. The cheapest qualifying candidate is SVRG K1 static at 411 conservative backwards/10 updates (395 with its disclosed identity shortcut), hence CASE A. This is a local feasibility screen, not training approval.
findings.costs_and_reporting: Conservative totals charge 251 per static full reference or 502 for refresh-5, plus 16K paired sample backprops per update. The report generator now states that the optional identity shortcut omits paired terms at update 0 (static) and updates 0 and 5 (refresh-5), while retaining full-reference cost. It distinguishes audit-cache reuse from deployable per-update cost and does not call these wall-clock benchmarks.
findings.scope: The report limits conclusions to the frozen states/draws, makes no initializer or long-horizon superiority claim, and says a later trajectory still needs full-objective and Armijo scalar/gradient-consistency qualification.

review.nonblocking_caveat: The selected two-DB exactification is ranked and evaluated on the same frozen panel; it is a descriptive counterfactual, not an independent confirmation.

next_experiment: A preregistered four-start × ten-update UNIT_MAXMIN qualification using SVRG K1 static chemistry only, keeping the shared manifest, initialization states and vector-Armijo controller unchanged. Not launched.
